item: row 289: the catalogue balance targets are read with a state, and a bad file never breaks the coverage view
summary: An unparsable or non-mapping configs/catalog_targets.yml raised out of GET /api/database/coverage and the coverage script, a non-number floor raised ValueError, and an absent file read like no target set; the read now has a state (present, absent, empty, unreadable), a bad value is refused per row with a token, every comparison is None with the state when the targets were not read, the panel says it in one line (x12), and a payload with unread targets carries its own TTL so a fixed file shows after 30 s even on an idle install.
